discrimination_assessment.next_iteration: Keep the 32-task size. Predeclare six challenge replacements within the 24 capability quota, centered on corrected documents/date roles, overlapping device uploads/local-day changes, dose-strength/version/intake separation, sparse cross-signal joins, constrained source-traceable handoffs and actual native context-summary retention.
